caption: The drawing depicts an anthropomorphic bundle or sack with human-like legs. The bundle is cinched at the top and tied with a large, pale green and cream bow. The main body of the bundle is rounded and textured, with a pleated or ruffled skirt-like element flaring out at the base in cream with green accents. The left side of the bundle features a smaller bow and pleated section, and another similarly styled large bow is present at the back. The two legs extending from the bottom are slender and wrapped in pale green and cream diagonal stripes, ending in pointed, high-heeled shoes that match the leg pattern. The composition is set against a plain beige or light tan background, with linework and delicate shading primarily in pencil and light green watercolor accents.
title: Cap
